description: Hexactra MCP server (hexactra-mcp): operate the user's browser through the control plane /v1 API.
instructions: These tools operate a real Chrome browser that belongs to the user and is signed in to their accounts. Typical loop: browser_navigate, then browser_elements to get CSS selectors, then browser_click / browser_type, then browser_text or browser_screenshot to check the result. Act at a human pace and only on the user's own behalf. If a page shows a CAPTCHA, a verification code, a passkey prompt, a payment confirmation or any other security check, call browser_request_human and wait for the person; never try to solve or bypass the check yourself. Browser actions are paused while a request to the person is open.
name: hexactra

tools.description: Pause and ask the user to do something only a person should do: solve a CAPTCHA, enter a one-time code, approve a passkey, sign in, or confirm a purchase. The user is reached on their configured channels (chat, email link, ...). With wait=true (default) this returns the outcome and, for input text/secret/choice, the person's answer. Use input=secret for one-time codes: type the value into the page and do not repeat it elsewhere.

input.description: none: the person acts in the browser and marks it done.
